phase: 6 - a flush failure that the unmount must refuse
how_the_failure_was_made: boot-arg xnusys_flush_fail=1 arms a one-shot refusal: the next flush reports failure without sending anything, the one after it works. A healthy device never fails a SYNCHRONIZE CACHE here, so without this the branch would never run.

observations.step: the volume after the second unmount

proof_dounmount_was_not_called: the kernel log has one 'from a lookup' line and then 'the flush was refused on purpose, staying mounted' with no 'calling dounmount'; the second attempt has both

two_mistakes_of_mine.what: the one-shot fault was consumed by an earlier program in rc
two_mistakes_of_mine.detail: unmount2 ran before flushfail and took it

two_mistakes_of_mine.what: the injection was only in the XNUSYS_FLUSH ioctl
two_mistakes_of_mine.detail: the unmount calls the driver directly and never passes through that check, so the fault was never seen and the unmount succeeded -- the test passed the wrong way round
two_mistakes_of_mine.fix: the unmount branch checks the flag itself
two_mistakes_of_mine.lesson: a test that only exercises the ioctl can miss the real call path

stage6_status.test_space: done, 176 MiB unowned and backed up
